narrative.overview:
STU is a quiet, task-focused construction CRM with an explicitly iOS-directed redesign. Beauty comes from precise hierarchy, readable financial information, grouped rows, restrained tint, and familiar navigation. This phrase summarizes the user's direction and the implemented system; it is not a separately approved brand metaphor.

This is a code-extracted record, not a claim of complete UIKit conversion or completed visual validation. The native detail navigation bars and iOS action sheets are real platform-backed surfaces. Large content headings and segmented controls are custom React Native components. Existing forms, charts, sheets, profile content, and expense rows still contain local styling.
keyCharacteristics: Grouped neutral surfaces with a restrained blue interaction tint.
Clear object identity, readable amounts, and separate work contexts.
Existing permissions and business behavior remain authoritative.

rules.name: The Palette Truth Rule
rules.body: These are theme-selected hex values inspired by iOS system colors, not dynamic UIKit semantic colors. Automatic increased-contrast or system-material adaptation is not established.

dos: Do use the iOS construction workspace as the design authority for this redesign.
Do reuse existing theme pairs, grouped rows, system-facing icons, and shared workspace controls.
Do preserve role checks, route destinations, API contracts, and stage-transition guards.
Do verify authenticated flows in the iOS simulator and report gaps explicitly.
donts: Don't introduce Android/Material styling as the redesign's visual authority.
Don't describe custom segmented controls or content headings as UIKit-native components.
Don't describe system-inspired hex tokens as dynamic semantic system colors.
Don't equate a passing typecheck or login screenshot with authenticated visual QA.
